title: FBI Photo A008
what_is_it: A still photograph submitted to AARO as a reported unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP), catalogued by the FBI.
interpretation_warnings: No source text could be extracted; all facts derive from war.gov metadata and a narrative description only.
Date and location of the event were never provided, so the image cannot be independently placed or corroborated.
The imagery was redacted before submission, meaning original context may be obscured.
The narrative description is explicitly for informational purposes only and reflects no analytical judgment or conclusion.
Single-source submission with no mission report; the operator themselves could not identify the object.

verifiable_claims.claim: The FBI submitted a still image of a reported UAP to AARO.
